remo-docs: just opened a tiny PR to update the audit-log retention section and replace outdated SDK snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/710

keisha-legal: quick legal flag: pls avoid words like 'forever' or 'permanently' in public docs. SOC2 reviewers prefer 'customer-configured' and an explicit legal-hold exception.

pat-eng: also noticed the Ruby snippet still uses `expire_seconds`. New API expects `retention_policy` hash. Quick fix:
```ruby
client.create_audit_log(tenant: 'org_77', retention_policy: {mode: 'ttl', seconds: 2592000}, pseudonymize: true)
```

remo-docs: thanks @pat-eng, will update Ruby/py/js. @anya-privacy any short one-liner we should use for the public page?

anya-privacy: propose: "Audit logs are retained according to customer-configured retention policies; Redwood does not retain logs beyond those settings except to comply with legal obligations (e.g., legal holds)."

keisha-legal: that wording is fine. prefer 'does not' not 'will not'. remove any direct links to internal legal playbooks and add '(contact support)' instead.

pat-eng: adding a CLI example for migration notes:
```
# inspect current policy
rctl audit get --tenant org_77 --json
# sample output
{"retention_policy": {"mode":"ttl","seconds":2592000}, "pseudonymize": false}
```

ci-bot: PR #710 checks  link-checker: warning (internal link removed), unit-tests: passed, lint: passed

remo-docs: replacing internal link with support pointer and updating snippets now. will merge after legal gives final ack. thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
